services.name: Skydive
services.desc: Skydive San Joaquin Valley gives you the opportunity to enjoy the exhilarating experience of tandem skydiving. After 15 minutes of ground instruction, you will ride to an altitude of 13,000 feet. You and your instructor are harnessed together as you jump out of the airplane. You get to feel the rush of flying at speeds of more than 120 mph. After about a minute of freefall, the parachute is deployed leading to a ten-minute canopy ride to bring you back to the ground. All of this while you take in the stunning views of three surrounding mountain ranges. A tandem jump is an excellent introduction to the exciting sport of skydiving.
